scope: Complete production WindowNetworkState constructor and exact DesignChrome initial metadata statements/update/renderLatest/refreshMetadata/applyMetadata methods. Deterministic Android view, handler/executor, preferences and catalogue adapters; synthetic preproduced runtime observation. New metrics-maintenance and persistence references are controlled unused boundaries in these direct chrome-render cases; the separate chat-chrome-performance-host suite executes those production methods. No Android scheduling, SQLite, native service or real network measurements.
